events.note: Imported from the legacy dossier: research verdict 'ready', tier T2 (tool-corroborated), researchedAt 2026-09-24. The verdict and tier are re-expressed as research.state and an evidence class; no product status is carried.

Legacy contract review text for 'twilio-auth-token' (verbatim legacy text; the date is the dossier researchedAt, not the authoring date): Twilio documents the Auth Token's functional role but no character-class grammar. The bare 32-character lowercase-hex shape, gated on a same-line Account SID or the word "twilio", is corroborated by TruffleHog's twilio detector; no pinned gitleaks rule covers this bare value.

Evidence review for issue 71 (2026-10-03, automation, not independently reviewed). Of the 9 fixtures held at legacy T2: messaging-service-sid-public-id, phone-number-public-id and signature-header-near-miss are re-based from project-policy to provider-documented (Twilio documents SIDs as 34 characters with an MG Messaging Service prefix, the E.164 phone number format, and the X-Twilio-Signature header as an HMAC-SHA1 signature; Twilio-owned CLI and Serverless Toolkit treat an Auth Token as exactly 32 characters; only 'not an Auth Token' is claimed). missing-identifier and package-md5-encoded-value are re-based to tool-corroborated (TruffleHog detector twilio at 363923b9 and CredSweeper rule 'Twilio Multi' at 6aa86333 both report a 32-hex value only with an Account SID; worded as consistency). The other 4 stay project-policy: account-sid-public-id, api-key-sid-masked-public-id and message-resource-public-id (each holds an AC, SK or SM id; Twilio names the Account SID and key sid among the credentials and tools disagree, so no two artifacts are consistent with silence and no provider page says the ids are public) and short-token (an AC id beside a 31-character value: Twilio-owned tooling supports 'a 31-character value is not an Auth Token' but the input also holds an Account SID, which Twilio lists as a credential component; whether to read the expectation family-scoped is a maintainer decision).
